title: NTA CSIR NET December 2025 E Certificate
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://csirnet.nta.nic.in
2. Open e-Certificate / DigiLocker section
3. Login with application number and password/DOB
4. Download e-certificate for JRF / Lectureship
5. Verify on DigiLocker if linked
shortDescription: NTA CSIR NET December 2025 E-Certificate download for qualified JRF/Assistant Professor candidates.
content:
NTA issues e-certificates for Joint CSIR-UGC NET qualified candidates (JRF and Lectureship / Assistant Professor eligibility).

December 2025 session qualified candidates can download digital certificates from the CSIR NET portal or DigiLocker after result processing. Keep application number safe.
